meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮你把聊天频道（比如Telegram、Slack）接到AI助手分组，管理会话隔离级别（同会话、共享记忆或完全隔离），添加同平台新群组，并检查/修复接线。
howto.when: 当你需要接入一个新频道（添加后或初始设置中）、在同一平台新增群组，或重新调整已有接线时触发；若还没有owner，会先引导运行`/init-first-agent`。

say.text: 把Telegram群'客户支持'接到新agent，用独立文件夹。
say.note: 会询问平台ID和隔离选项后注册。

say.text: 让现有Slack频道和刚才那个agent共享工作区但分开会话。
帮我看看有没有频道只配了凭证但没接好。
say.note: 它会查询数据库并给出可读配置摘要。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude wires messaging channels (e.g. Telegram, Slack) to agent groups, manages session isolation (same session, shared memory, or full isolation), adds new groups on the same platform, and checks/fixes wiring.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to wire in a new channel (after adding it or during setup), add another group on the same platform, or rewire existing connections. If no owner exists yet, it first prompts to run `/init-first-agent`.

say_en.text: Attach the Telegram group 'Customer Support' to a new agent in its own folder.
say_en.note: Asks for platform ID and isolation choice, then registers.

say_en.text: Wire the Slack channel to that agent with shared memory, separate sessions.
say_en.note: Adds a wiring in 'shared' session mode.

say_en.text: Show me any channels with credentials but not wired.
say_en.note: Queries the DB and shows a readable config summary.
